#==============================================================================

#  game over propio.

#------------------------------------------------------------------------------
# Utilidad: texto centrado sobre negro
#------------------------------------------------------------------------------
module Vacas
  def self.sprite_texto(lineas, y0, alto = 30, tam = 22, color = nil)
    s = Sprite.new
    s.bitmap = Bitmap.new(640, 480)
    s.bitmap.font.size = tam
    c = color
    if c.nil?
      c = Color.new(210, 200, 180)
    end
    s.bitmap.font.color = c
    y = y0
    for l in lineas
      s.bitmap.draw_text(0, y, 640, alto, l, 1)
      y += alto
    end
    return s
  end
end

#==============================================================================
# ** Scene_Aviso - aviso de contenido (solo al arrancar el juego)
#==============================================================================
class Scene_Aviso
  def main
    @fondo = Sprite.new
    @fondo.bitmap = Bitmap.new(640, 480)
    @fondo.bitmap.fill_rect(0, 0, 640, 480, Color.new(0, 0, 0))
    @titulo = Vacas.sprite_texto(["AVISO DE CONTENIDO"], 70, 36, 28,
      Color.new(190, 40, 34))
    lineas = [
      "Vacas es un juego de terror psicológico para adultos.",
      "",
      "Contiene maltrato familiar y psicológico, violencia,",
      "sangre, imágenes perturbadoras sobre la carne y los",
      "animales de matadero, y temas de salud mental.",
      "",
      "No contiene escenas sexuales.",
      "",
      "Si en algún momento te hace daño, para. El juego espera."
    ]
    @texto = Vacas.sprite_texto(lineas, 140, 28, 20)
    @pie = Vacas.sprite_texto(["Pulsa Intro para continuar"], 420, 28, 16,
      Color.new(140, 130, 115))
    @pie.opacity = 0
    @espera = 0
    Graphics.transition(40)
    loop do
      Graphics.update
      Input.update
      @espera += 1
      if @espera > 60
        @pie.opacity = 120 + (Graphics.frame_count % 60) * 2
      else
        @pie.opacity = 0
      end
      if @espera > 60 and Input.trigger?(Input::C)
        $scene = Scene_Title.new
      end
      break if $scene != self
    end
    Graphics.freeze
    for s in [@fondo, @titulo, @texto, @pie]
      s.bitmap.dispose
      s.dispose
    end
    Graphics.transition(30)
    Graphics.freeze
  end
end

#==============================================================================
# ** Scene_FinActo - "Fin del Acto I / II"
#   Acto 1: al pulsar Intro sigue en el Acto II (misma partida).
#   Acto 2: vuelve al titulo.
#==============================================================================
class Scene_FinActo
  TEXTOS = {
    1 => ["Fin del Acto I", "El piso", "Acto II: La cadena", "Pulsa Intro para seguir"],
    2 => ["Fin del Acto II", "La cadena", "Acto III: Lucy", "Pulsa Intro para seguir"],
    3 => ["Fin del Acto III", "Lucy", "Acto IV: Bajo la ciudad", "Pulsa Intro para seguir"],
    4 => ["Fin del Acto IV", "Bajo la ciudad", "Acto V: La matanza", "Pulsa Intro para seguir"],
    5 => ["Fin del Acto V", "La matanza", "Acto VI: Rey-dios", "Pulsa Intro para seguir"]
  }
  def initialize(acto = 1)
    @acto = acto
  end
  def main
    Audio.bgm_fade(2000)
    Audio.bgs_fade(2000)
    t = TEXTOS[@acto]
    @fondo = Sprite.new
    @fondo.bitmap = Bitmap.new(640, 480)
    @fondo.bitmap.fill_rect(0, 0, 640, 480, Color.new(0, 0, 0))
    @fin = Vacas.sprite_texto([t[0]], 170, 50, 40, Color.new(170, 30, 26))
    @sub = Vacas.sprite_texto([t[1]], 224, 32, 22)
    @sig = Vacas.sprite_texto([t[2]], 330, 28, 18, Color.new(140, 130, 115))
    @pie = Vacas.sprite_texto([t[3]], 420, 24, 14, Color.new(110, 100, 90))
    for s in [@fin, @sub, @sig, @pie]
      s.opacity = 0
    end
    Graphics.transition(60)
    $game_system.me_play(RPG::AudioFile.new("015-Mystery01", 80, 70))
    @t = 0
    loop do
      Graphics.update
      Input.update
      @t += 1
      @fin.opacity = (@t - 20) * 3 if @t > 20
      @sub.opacity = (@t - 100) * 3 if @t > 100
      @sig.opacity = (@t - 200) * 2 if @t > 200
      @pie.opacity = 60 + (@t % 80) * 2 if @t > 260
      if @t > 260 and Input.trigger?(Input::C)
        if @acto == 1
          Vacas.empezar_acto2
          $scene = Scene_Map.new
        elsif @acto == 2
          Vacas.empezar_acto3
          $scene = Scene_Map.new
        elsif @acto == 3
          Vacas.empezar_acto4
          $scene = Scene_Map.new
        elsif @acto == 4
          Vacas.empezar_acto5
          $scene = Scene_Map.new
        elsif @acto == 5
          Vacas.empezar_acto6
          $scene = Scene_Map.new
        else
          $scene = Scene_Title.new
        end
      end
      break if $scene != self
    end
    Graphics.freeze
    for s in [@fondo, @fin, @sub, @sig, @pie]
      s.bitmap.dispose
      s.dispose
    end
    Graphics.transition(60)
    Graphics.freeze
  end
end

# Vacas: interfaz completa. RGSS1 / Ruby 1.8. Instalar despues de BajoCiudad.
module Vacas_Config
  FILE = 'Vacas.cfg'
  DEFAULTS = {:bgm=>80, :bgs=>70, :se=>80, :me=>80, :texto=>2,
    :brillo=>100, :intensidad=>70, :subtitulos=>true}
  def self.values
    return @values if @values
    @values = DEFAULTS.clone
    begin
      data = File.open(FILE, 'rb') { |f| Marshal.load(f) }
      DEFAULTS.each do |k,v|
        n = data[k] if data.is_a?(Hash)
        if v == true
          @values[k] = n if n == true || n == false
        elsif n.is_a?(Numeric)
          limits = k == :texto ? [1,4] : (k == :brillo ? [50,150] : [0,100])
          @values[k] = [[n.to_i,limits[0]].max,limits[1]].min
        end
      end
    rescue StandardError
      # Config ausente/corrupta: valores seguros, no afecta a las partidas.
    end
    @values
  end
  def self.get(k); values[k]; end
  def self.set(k,v); values[k]=v; end
  def self.save
    begin
      File.open(FILE+'.tmp','wb') { |f| Marshal.dump(values,f) }
      File.delete(FILE+'.bak') if FileTest.exist?(FILE+'.bak')
      File.rename(FILE,FILE+'.bak') if FileTest.exist?(FILE)
      File.rename(FILE+'.tmp',FILE)
      true
    rescue StandardError
      File.rename(FILE+'.bak',FILE) if !FileTest.exist?(FILE) && FileTest.exist?(FILE+'.bak')
      false
    end
  end
end

module Audio
  class << self
    def vacas_tracks; @vacas_tracks ||= {}; end
    alias vacas_original_bgm_play bgm_play
    alias vacas_original_bgs_play bgs_play
    alias vacas_original_se_play se_play
    alias vacas_original_me_play me_play
    def vacas_dispatch(kind,original,args)
        name=args[0]; volume=args[1] || 100; pitch=args[2] || 100
        base=File.basename(name.to_s).sub(/\.[^.]+$/, '')
        key=Vacas_Audio::LEGACY[base]
        key=Vacas_Audio.screamer if base=='092-Attack04' && Vacas_Audio.screamer
        if [:llave_recoger,:papel_nota,:recoger_objeto,:frasco_de_vidrio].include?(key)
          return unless Vacas_Audio.allow_pickup?
        end
        if key && kind==:bgs && $game_map && Vacas_Audio::MAP_AUDIO[$game_map.map_id]
          key=Vacas_Audio::MAP_AUDIO[$game_map.map_id][2]
        end
        if key
          row=Vacas_Audio::TABLE[key]
          name='Audio/'+kind.to_s.upcase+'/'+row[1]
          volume=[volume,row[2]].min; pitch=row[3]
        end
        vacas_tracks[kind]=[name,volume,pitch] if [:bgm,:bgs].include?(kind)
        if key==:susto || base==Vacas_Audio::TABLE[:susto][1] || base.index('se_screamer_')==0 || key.to_s.index('screamer_')==0
          volume=volume*Vacas_Config.get(:intensidad)/100
        end
        if Vacas_Audio.path?(name.to_s)
          Vacas_Audio.subtitle(row[4]) if key
          send(original,name,volume*Vacas_Config.get(kind)/100,pitch)
        elsif [:bgm,:bgs].include?(kind)
          send(kind.to_s+'_stop')
        end
    end
    def bgm_play(*args); vacas_dispatch(:bgm,:vacas_original_bgm_play,args); end
    def bgs_play(*args); vacas_dispatch(:bgs,:vacas_original_bgs_play,args); end
    def se_play(*args); vacas_dispatch(:se,:vacas_original_se_play,args); end
    def me_play(*args); vacas_dispatch(:me,:vacas_original_me_play,args); end
    alias vacas_original_bgm_stop bgm_stop
    alias vacas_original_bgs_stop bgs_stop
    def bgm_stop; vacas_tracks.delete(:bgm); vacas_original_bgm_stop; end
    def bgs_stop; vacas_tracks.delete(:bgs); vacas_original_bgs_stop; end
  end
end

# Creditos completos del pack, incluidos autores secundarios, obras y enlaces.
# Se pagina texto ya ajustado al ancho real de la fuente, incluidas URL largas.
class Scene_VacasCredits
  def main
    @background=Vacas_UI.background('titulo')
    @panel=Window_VacasPanel.new(24,64,592,350)
    @footer=Window_VacasPanel.new(24,416,592,64)
    @page=0; @lines=Vacas_Audio::CREDITS_LINES
    @pages=[(@lines.size+11)/12,1].max
    draw
    Vacas_UI.loop_scene(self)
    @panel.dispose; @footer.dispose; @background.dispose
  end
  def draw
    @panel.contents.clear
    12.times do |i|
      line=@lines[@page*12+i]
      b=@panel.contents; b.font.name='Courier New'; b.font.size=16; b.font.color=Vacas_UI::INK
      b.draw_text(4,i*25,548,25,line) if line
    end
    @footer.contents.clear
    Vacas_UI.text(@footer.contents,0,0,552,
      'Creditos '+(@page+1).to_s+'/'+@pages.to_s+'  Flechas: pagina  Esc: titulo',16)
  end
  def update
    @background.update
    if Input.trigger?(Input::B)
      Vacas_Audio.play(:cancelar); $scene=Scene_Title.new; return
    end
    delta=0
    delta=1 if Input.repeat?(Input::RIGHT) || Input.repeat?(Input::DOWN) || Input.trigger?(Input::C)
    delta=-1 if Input.repeat?(Input::LEFT) || Input.repeat?(Input::UP)
    next_page=[[@page+delta,0].max,@pages-1].min
    if next_page!=@page
      @page=next_page; Vacas_Audio.play(:cursor); draw
    end
  end
end

module Vacas_Audio
  def self.allow_pickup?
    now=Graphics.frame_count
    return false if @pickup_frame && now>=@pickup_frame && now-@pickup_frame<10
    @pickup_frame=now; true
  end
  def self.pickup(key)
    play(key) if allow_pickup?
  end
end
class Game_Party
  alias audio_gain_item gain_item
  def gain_item(id,n)
    before=item_number(id)
    audio_gain_item(id,n)
    if n>0 && item_number(id)>before && $scene.is_a?(Scene_Map)
      name=$data_items[id] ? $data_items[id].name.downcase : ''
      key=name.include?('llave') ? :llave_recoger : :recoger_objeto
      key=:papel_nota if [4,6,8,9,10,11,13,15,23,24,28,33,34].include?(id)
      key=:frasco_de_vidrio if name.include?('tarro') || name.include?('frasco')
      Vacas_Audio.pickup(key)
    end
  end
end
module Vacas
  class << self
    alias audio_actualizar_linterna actualizar_linterna
    def actualizar_linterna
      before=$game_switches[115]
      audio_actualizar_linterna
      if before!=$game_switches[115] && @audio_recharge_frame!=Graphics.frame_count
        Vacas_Audio.play(:linterna_clic)
      end
    end
    alias audio_recargar recargar
    def recargar
      result=audio_recargar
      if result
        @audio_recharge_frame=Graphics.frame_count
        Vacas_Audio.play(:linterna_clic)
      end
      result
    end
  end
end

    return 1 if $game_switches[160]
    return 2 if $game_switches[161]
    return 3 if $game_switches[162]
    return 0
  end
  def self.empezar_acto6
    return unless $game_switches[163] && rama6 > 0
    $game_switches[176] = true
    for id in [26,29,30,31,120,122,142,150,185]
      $game_switches[id] = false
    end
    detener_caza
    $game_system.timer_working = false
    $game_system.menu_disabled = false
    $game_system.save_disabled = false
    $game_player.transparent = false
    $game_temp.player_new_map_id = 28

    $game_temp.player_new_direction = 8
    $game_temp.player_transferring = true
    $game_temp.transition_processing = false
  end
  def self.prueba_acto6(rama, cruel = false)
    prueba_acto5(cruel)
    for id in [145,147,151,156,159,163]
      $game_switches[id] = true
    end
    for id in 160..162
      $game_switches[id] = (id == 159 + rama)
    end
    $game_switches[96] = !cruel
    $game_switches[97] = cruel
    $game_switches[147] = !cruel
    $game_switches[171] = cruel
    $game_switches[145] = !cruel
    $game_variables[58] = cruel ? 5 : 1
    $game_variables[59] = cruel ? 0 : 4
    empezar_acto6
    $game_temp.player_transferring = false
    $game_map.setup(28)
    $game_player.moveto(3,13)
    $game_player.turn_up
    $game_map.autoplay
    $game_map.update
  end
  def self.finales_vistos
    return [] unless FileTest.exist?('Vacas_finales.dat')
    # Formato de texto acotado; nunca deserializa contenido externo.
    data = File.open('Vacas_finales.dat','rb') { |f| f.read(32) }
    return data.scan(/[123]/).collect { |n| n.to_i }.uniq.sort
  rescue
    return []
  end
  def self.registrar_final(rama)
    return unless (1..3).include?(rama)
    $game_switches[188] = true
    $game_switches[188 + rama] = true
    $game_variables[68] = rama
    begin
      seen = (finales_vistos + [rama]).uniq.sort
      File.open('Vacas_finales.tmp','wb') { |f| f.write(seen.join(',')) }
      File.delete('Vacas_finales.dat') if FileTest.exist?('Vacas_finales.dat')
      File.rename('Vacas_finales.tmp','Vacas_finales.dat')
    rescue
      # El final sigue disponible aunque el directorio sea de solo lectura.
    end
  end

    alias reydios_tareas_antes tareas
    def tareas
      return reydios_tareas_antes unless $game_switches[176]
      s = $game_switches
      return [['La historia ha terminado.',true]] if s[188]
      return [['Altar: escuchar a la manada y afrontar el trono.',false]] if s[184]
      return [['Galeria: cerrar izquierda, centro y derecha.',false]] if s[181]
      return [['Ciudad: volver a casa. Madre y Perro siguen arriba.',false]] if s[179]
      return [['Tuneles: escuchar la tuberia y subir a la ciudad.',false]]
    end
  end

class Interpreter
  def reydios_iniciar_tension
    return true if $game_switches[184]
    $game_switches[185] = true
    $game_variables[65] = 0
    $game_variables[66] = 40 * 35
    $game_system.menu_disabled = true
    $game_system.save_disabled = true
    return true
  end
  def reydios_valvula(n)
    return true unless $game_switches[185]
    if $game_variables[65] == n-1
      $game_variables[65] = n
      Vacas_Audio.play(:cadena_gancho)
      if n == 3
        $game_switches[184] = true
        $game_switches[185] = false
        $game_system.menu_disabled = false
        $game_system.save_disabled = false
        $game_map.need_refresh = true
      end
    else
      $game_variables[66] = [$game_variables[66]-120,40].max
      Vacas_Audio.play(:cadena_gancho)
    end
    return true
  end
  def reydios_jefe
    id = 34 + Vacas.rama6
    # La piedad facilita resistir; el dominio da más cuerpo a la visión.
    hp = 780 + $game_variables[58]*35 - $game_variables[59]*25
    $data_enemies[id].maxhp = [[hp,650].max,990].min
    return true
  end
  def reydios_terminar
    Vacas.registrar_final(Vacas.rama6)
    $scene = Scene_FinalVacas.new(Vacas.rama6)
    return true
  end
end
